intro.sub: It's a conversation, not a form. No question is about design — they're about your business.

detail.title: Detail becomes content
detail.body: Everything you say here becomes the base of every piece the engine writes. “Sourdough bread, baked at 6 a.m.” goes further than “bakery”.

help.title: Stuck? Ask “make it for me”
help.body: Color, font, way of speaking: if you don't have it, the platform proposes options with a preview. You choose.

later.title: Nothing here is final
later.body: You can change everything later and keep adding. The more the brand knows about itself, the sharper the content.

intro.footer: // about 3 minutes. you can leave halfway and pick up where you stopped.

opening.intro: Let's build your brand's brandcore. I ask, you answer your way. If you get stuck on one, ask “make it for me”.
opening.first: First: what's the brand called and what does it sell?

questions.brand: What's the brand called and what does it sell?
questions.audience: Who is it for? Describe the customer you most want to attract.
questions.differential: What makes someone choose you over a competitor?
questions.voice: How does the brand talk? Give me a sentence it would say in a post.
questions.banned: And what would it never say? Words, tone, topics that stay out.
questions.offers: Main products or services, with prices if you have them.
questions.logo: Do you have a logo? Send it here or ask “make it for me”.
questions.palette: Colors and font: do you have them or should we propose?
questions.fonts: Colors and font: do you have them or should we propose?

agent.followUpGeneric: Can you be more specific? The more detail, the better the engine writes.
agent.adjustAsk: What do you want to adjust? Tell me the topic and the new value.
agent.fontMissing: {{font}} isn't in the catalog. Ask “make it for me” and I'll propose three that come close.
agent.wordmarkNoted: Noted. I'll draw the wordmark at the end, with the font you choose.
agent.logoOpaque: This logo has a solid background. On dark pieces a white box will show around it. If you can, send the version with a transparent background.

suggest.voice: Three ways of speaking, based on what you told me. Click the one that sounds like your brand.
suggest.palette: Three palettes, based on what you told me. Click the one that looks like your brand.
suggest.fonts: Three font pairs. Click the one that fits the palette.

onboarding.resume: We stopped here: {{topic}}. Shall we continue?
onboarding.chip: not sure — make it for me

summary.body: Check the summary. If it's right, publish and the engine starts working with it. If not, tell me what to adjust.

errors.modelDown: The engine didn't respond. Your answer was saved. Try again.
errors.offline: No connection. Nothing was lost. Come back when the network does.
errors.logoUpload: The logo didn't upload. Try again or ask “make it for me”.
errors.publish: Not published. The brandcore is saved as a draft. Try again in a moment.

preview.name: Your brand
preview.concept: What you do shows up here.
